title: Extension of scalars preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms
statement: For commutative rings R and B in the same universe and any ring map rho:R→B, the additive functor ModuleCat.extendScalars rho sends every quasi-isomorphism between K-flat cochain complexes of R-modules to a quasi-isomorphism of B-complexes (Functor.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso). No flatness hypothesis on B over R is required.

source.place: Tags 064L and 06Y0; specialization of the mixed total-tensor K-flat comparison

proof.text: Specialize clause (i) of mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso to the B-module tensor unit concentrated in degree zero. The natural single-complex comparison followed by the tensor left unitor identifies this mixed total tensor with termwise extendScalars. Their naturality gives an isomorphism of arrows, so quasiIso_iff_of_arrow_mk_iso transports the quasi-isomorphism to termwise scalar extension. Package this as Functor.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso. The Lean implementation reuses the already proved private scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat helper implementing this argument, through a proof-only import all; it does not use the homology-equivalence statement of lem-sc-kflat-scalar-extension-derived-iso.

proof_origin.note: Public class bridge to the existing private scalar-extension quasi-isomorphism lemma; reuse its proof rather than repeat it; no new hole.
